review_type: Independent ordered-still visual review of the completed nine-state standard atlas
method: Viewed complete atlas/contact sheet, then all 57 native 192x208 frame PNGs in temporal order. Read-only Pillow comparison confirmed every required atlas cell exactly equals its corresponding reviewed frame. Verified GIF frame counts and stored durations as metadata only. Image tools show ordered stills; this review did NOT observe live animation playback and cannot certify temporal smoothness at actual playback speed.

warnings.evidence: Both gaits show extension, compression and flight/recovery changes, but near/far leg identity is partly obscured by overlapping identical boots and coat. No clear directional reversal or frozen gait was observed in the ordered stills.

Jump begins and ends in a deliberate crouch. The idle-to-jump boundary therefore changes silhouette/head height; face, hair and boots retain comparable size. This is visible anticipation/landing rather than a whole-character scale jump. Playback timing still needs motion preview/user inspection.

identity.evidence: Across all states, rich layered green hair, curled tuft, mint goggles above eyes, longer ivory flared coat with lapels and folded cuffs, diagonal bodice trim, pleated skirt/ivory hem and tall cuffed piped boots remain readable at native cell size. Side-running views occlude some front decoration naturally. No plain-dress or ankle-boot replacement seen.

registration.evidence: Grounded static states keep feet close to the same baseline and retain transparent safe padding; no visible cell clipping or neighbor bleed. Row poses vary in head tilt, hair spread and crouch naturally. Atlas/frame pixel comparisons passed for every required cell.

states.evidence: Calm fixed stance with open eyes, full blink in frame 2, subtle settling; frames 0 and 5 very close. Feet planted.
All face screen-right; forward lean, rearward coat/hair, changing forward-extended versus flexed boot positions and bent/extended arms form a readable directional gait; no direction reversal.
All face screen-left; opposite travel orientation with rearward coat/hair to the right. Distinct stride extension, tucked recovery and support silhouettes across ordered frames.
Attached hand rises from cheek height to above shoulder, closes eyes happily, then lowers; feet remain planted, no drawn wave arcs.

Crouch, rising open-arm pose, tucked airborne apex, descent, matching crouched landing. Apex soles visibly lift above baseline; head and boot scale stays comparable to idle and adjacent jump poses. No shadow/landing effects.
Surprise, worried raised hands, clasped/slumped posture, sad closed eyes, embarrassed cheek touch/peek and recovery. No detached tears/symbols.
Hands clasped in request then both open palms presented expectantly, brief blink/head inclination, returns to clasp. Distinct from resting idle.
Planted thoughtful processing sequence through chin hand, temple touch, goggles/head touch and closed-eye concentration. No foot-running.
Forward examining lean with low hands, narrowed eyes, attached hand adjusts existing forehead goggles, satisfied blink/nod, opposite inspection tilt and return. Goggles stay above eyes; no new props.
